mapper.update: UPDATE invoice_requests SET status = IF(#{failureCode} IS NULL, 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED'), invoice_no = #{invoiceNo}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, completed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
